React Bits HalftoneReveal by David Haz

Source commit: 4dc7b5b7772e1217c8fb8d2a7aa074302180e5b4
https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/4dc7b5b7772e1217c8fb8d2a7aa074302180e5b4/src/content/Animations/HalftoneReveal/HalftoneReveal.jsx

Used as part of the KICKS website. Original vertex/mask shaders and native WebGL2 rendering approach retained. The view shader is extended to composite a player texture through the original mask in the same context. React lifecycle replaced by vanilla JavaScript; Hero event routing and image-frame alignment added.
